title: Modustro Global Publication Deploy Metadata v1
description: Deployment-controlled publication metadata generated from validated user metadata plus trusted publisher state. This document is not an author input contract.

GlobalPublicationPathId.description: Stable logical publication path copied from validated user metadata.

PublicationState.description: Server-controlled publication lifecycle state. Released definitions are immutable and cannot transition back to draft.

PublicationRevision.description: Server-controlled monotonically increasing revision of successfully deployed draft content. Release freezes the current content revision.

FirstPublishedAt.description: Server-generated timestamp of the first successful deployment for this GlobalPublicationPathId.

PublishedAt.description: Server-generated timestamp of the most recent successful deployment or release transition represented by this metadata.

ReleasedAt.description: Server-generated timestamp at which this publication became an immutable release; absent while the publication is a draft.

PublishedBy.description: Optional trusted publisher identity derived by the deployment adapter from authenticated execution context; never copied from user metadata.
